verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show adding conversation/document content as memories via API (client.add with containerTag), automatic memory extraction, and hybrid semantic search/retrieval (search.md, graph traversal, user profiles) that persists across sessions via container tags. This directly matches the story of adding memories from conversations and retrieving them later with semantic search. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of retrieval quality/persistence beyond vendor docs, and one community report noting large content ingestion errors suggests some practical limits.
